name: Antiphon Vael, the Unbending
body: an ancient enthroned hierarch fused into salt-stiff ceremonial plate, unable to walk, seated rigid atop a litter-palanquin built of sealed faceted memory-crystals carried on four bell-hung poles; one fused hand grips a tall crozier topped with a bronze bell-and-anvil finial, a blindfold bound over the eyes, layered salt-crusted robes, hourglasses and reliquary lockets chained across the chest. Static, monumental, throne-like; the palanquin is the integral base.
caption: Antiphon Vael, the Unbending — Set Hierarch / Warlord (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: The Two Witnesses (Concord & Antiphony)
body: a bonded pair of twin witness-priests on one shared base, standing back-to-back yet leaning together, each blindfolded and raising a slender attestation-rod tipped with a small bell; matching salt-stiff vestments and bronze chest-icons, a mirror-image stance as if mid-oath with one hand of each clasped to the other's shoulder. Two figures, one base.
caption: The Two Witnesses (Concord & Antiphony) — Paired support characters (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Attesting Acolytes
body: a junior archivist wading forward in a half-crouch, both hands reaching out and down as if laying palms on an unseen crystal, a small salt-rimed knife sheathed at the belt; light flexible hooded vestments crusted with salt rime, a folded litany-cloth over one forearm, blindfold bound. Humble, devotional, defenceless.
caption: Attesting Acolytes — Objective-holder line infantry (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Chime-Wardens
body: a still marksman locked in a fixed planted firing-stance, a long heavy attestation longgun — an ornate bronze-bodied muzzle-loading rifle hung with a small chime-bell — braced to the shoulder and aimed level; salt-stiffened layered robes, a bell at the hip, blindfold raised just off the eyes. Rooted, patient, motionless.
caption: Chime-Wardens — Defensive overwatch shooters (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Verdigris Wardens
body: a heavy bastion warrior in thick oxidised reliquary-bronze plate caked with verdigris and barnacle-salt, standing immovable with a two-handed reliquary maul grounded head-down before him like an anvil; a tall bronze tower-icon banner rises from the backpack, a blindfolded helm, salt-rime over every surface. Bulky, planted, defensive.
caption: Verdigris Wardens — Elite durable bastion infantry (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: The Sealing Choir
body: a robed choir-singer mid-hymn, head tilted back and mouth open in song, one hand raised and the other holding a tall hymn-staff hung with a censer trailing moulded incense-smoke; flowing layered choir vestments, a blindfold, a small sacrament-thurible at the belt. Ceremonial, upward, lyrical.
caption: The Sealing Choir — Objective-Setter sacrament specialists (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Pilgrim-Bearers of the Sealed Vault
body: a stooped pilgrim-bearer bent under a tall reliquary back-frame that cradles a single large faceted memory-crystal; both arms wrapped protectively around the load, no weapon, head bowed, heavy salt-crusted robes, a trudging burdened gait. Devoted and defenceless.
caption: Pilgrim-Bearers of the Sealed Vault — Litany-carrier / objective courier (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Lector of the Permitted Truth
body: a stooped witness-priest reciting from a thick chained codex held open in one hand, the other swinging a small index-censer on a short chain; round iodine-blind spectacles over salt-clouded eyes, layered robes, a satchel of scrolls at the hip. Scholarly, half-blind, mid-recitation.
caption: Lector of the Permitted Truth — Witness substitute / re-roll support (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Reliquary Sentinels
body: an immobile gun-shrine: a heavy harpoon-organ — a small bronze pipe-organ fused to a great barbed harpoon-launcher — mounted on a bolted tripod reliquary, with a single anchored crewman in heavy salt-plate sighting along it, both feet fused into the base. A static emplacement, one crew figure, the tripod integral to the base.
caption: Reliquary Sentinels — Static heavy fire-anchor gun crew (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Vael-Who-Is-Nothing-Yet
role: First Cantor of the Cooling-Slag Choir
body: a lean cantor-priestess in cracked slag-plate over charred rags, her face hidden behind a fractured crack-line mask, striding forward with a long ornate salt-pick (a glowing pick-hammer) raised in one hand and a smoking iodine censer swinging from a chain in the other; moulded wisps of censer-smoke, ash-scarred bare arms. Commanding, mid-stride, ecstatic.
caption: Vael-Who-Is-Nothing-Yet — First Cantor of the Cooling-Slag Choir (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Korrun the Match
body: a wiry bare-chested penitent in tattered crack-lined rags with no armour, fresh joining-scars carved across his torso, caught mid-leap with a salt-pick in each raised hand crossed overhead, head thrown back laughing with mouth wide; a dynamic twisting lunge, frayed rag-strips flying. Frenzied, jubilant, airborne.
caption: Korrun the Match — Last-Voice Penitent (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Slag-Pick Penitent
body: a scarred penitent in ragged crack-lined sackcloth, no armour, charging with a single iodine-heated salt-pick swung back in a one-handed downward strike, the other arm flung wide for balance, eye-sockets bound in scorched cloth. Aggressive, simple, a cheap line-trooper.
caption: Slag-Pick Penitent — Cheap aggressive line infantry (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Scour-Walker
body: a lithe barefoot skirmisher sprinting low on salt-crusted feet, a salt-pick held out ahead in one hand and a small hand-censer trailing smoke in the other; minimal scorched wrappings, lean and fast, leaning hard into the run. Swift, forward-pitched.
caption: Scour-Walker — Fast skirmisher / objective-breaker (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Iodine Censer-Thrower
body: a penitent in a heavy censer-harness of chains and hooks across the back, winding up to hurl a large iodine censer overhand on a long chain, body coiled in the throw; spare censers clipped to the harness, scorched wrappings. Mid-throw, coiled, an artillery pose.
caption: Iodine Censer-Thrower — Mid-range shatter artillery (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Cantor-Breaker
body: a commanding zealot in slag-plate, one hand cupped to the ear listening and the other holding a slender tuning-pick struck upright like a tuning fork, an iodine censer hanging at the hip; head cocked and attentive, mid-gesture as if conducting. Poised, listening, a leader silhouette.
caption: Cantor-Breaker — Field commander / shatter-support beacon (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Voice of the Last Hour
body: a massive blind veteran encased in heavy cooling-slag carapace plates, hauling an enormous two-handed great slag-maul over one shoulder and marching ponderously forward; a censer chained to the waist, a seared featureless face, hulking bulk. Heavy, slow, brutal.
caption: Voice of the Last Hour — Heavy elite zone-denial bruiser (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Ash-Anchorite
body: a solitary hooded assassin wrapped head-to-foot in a tattered scour-shroud cloak, crouched low and creeping, a slim whisper-pick reversed along the forearm in an icepick grip; the face lost in shadow under the hood, a stealthy coiled stance. Lone, furtive, predatory.
caption: Ash-Anchorite — Lone hunter / Litany assassin (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Glass-Wraith Detonator
body: a gaunt penitent whose torso is visibly packed and bound with bundled crack-lined glass shards and iodine-salt charges strapped under torn rags, lurching forward arms spread wide in a final embrace, a salt-pick loose in one hand, ribs and bottles bulging the wrappings. Doomed, lurching.
caption: Glass-Wraith Detonator — Suicide shock / guaranteed shatter (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Litter of the Choir
body: a blind robed Voice seated cross-legged and serene atop a salt-encrusted litter, one arm extended pointing imperiously; the litter borne on poles by two stooped chained penitent bearers with picks at their belts, gaunt and yoked. A three-figure group — rider plus two bearers — on one litter base.
caption: Litter of the Choir — Command monster / blind-faith engine (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Cooling-Slag Cantor
body: a zealot in slag-plate standing spread-armed with a hand-censer swinging from each fist on long chains and a tuning-pick thrust through the belt, head thrown back as if calling out, twin smoke-trails curling; a defiant cruciform stance. Broadcasting, arms outstretched.
caption: Cooling-Slag Cantor — Subfaction beacon / volley caller (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Vael Surr, the Iodine Comptroller
body: a poised merchant-comptroller in a long oilskin coat and patinaed scale-trim, standing with a heavy open-ledger gavel — a gavel whose head is a tiny set of brass scales — raised in one hand and a corked iodine flask in the other ready to throw; a chained strongbox-purse at the hip, a half-veil over the eyes, sharp imperious posture. Commanding, mercantile.
caption: Vael Surr, the Iodine Comptroller — Warlord / Coin Generator (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: The Auctioneer-Adept
body: a theatrical auctioneer mid-call, one arm thrown up brandishing a salt-glass gavel and the other hooking a long crier's pole-hook; a flared oilskin coat, ledger-scrolls spilling from a satchel, mouth open mid-cry, leaning out over the bidding. Animated, gesturing, a showman.
caption: The Auctioneer-Adept — Hero Support / Tempo-Control (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Cutpurse Wavewalkers
body: a nimble cutpurse in a hooded oilskin slicker wading fast, a bladed wading-pole planted to vault forward, one hand snatching out as if pocketing something; a small ledger-stone tablet on a thong at the neck, a sly crouched balance. Quick, light-fingered, in motion.
caption: Cutpurse Wavewalkers — Cheap fast objective-snatcher (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Skiff-Reach Corsairs
body: a corsair riding a small lashed-plank tide-skiff with a brass-shod prow, knees bent and leaning into the glide, swinging a long gaff-hook out to one side, a salvage net coiled at the foot of a short mast; the skiff is the integral base with moulded spray at the prow. Mounted, dynamic, raiding.
caption: Skiff-Reach Corsairs — Fast cavalry / harasser (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Factor-Clerks of the Open Book
body: a prim clerk in a long buttoned ledger-coat and a sash, holding a huge open ledger-stone tablet balanced on one forearm while writing on it with a chalk-stylus, peering down through a pince-nez; no weapon, a fastidious bookkeeper's stance. Bureaucratic, absorbed, unarmed.
caption: Factor-Clerks of the Open Book — Support / Coin engine / Editor (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Ironbound Bodyguard-Clerks
body: a burly bodyguard-clerk in a heavy patinaed scale-coat, one fist on a grounded debt-collector's maul and the other cuffed by a short shackle-chain to a strongbox vault clutched against the hip; a broad protective stance over the strongbox, jaw set. Heavy, guarding, immovable.
caption: Ironbound Bodyguard-Clerks — Durable mid-line / Coin protection (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: The Iodine-Blind
body: a hunched forger wearing a memory-blind blindfold, levelling a long brass iodine-spitter — a bellows-pumped sprayer — in two hands; a counterfeit salt-press device clamped to the back belching moulded vapour, a stained oilskin apron, a furtive aim. Skulking, spraying, disruptive.
caption: The Iodine-Blind — Glass-cannon disruptor / Forger (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: The Hauler-Sledge
body: a massive low cargo-sledge of lashed barrels and planks forming a vault-bed heaped with scooped faceted crystals, a long articulated salvage-claw scoop-rig mounted at the front, dragged forward by one straining harnessed clerk leaning into a tow-rope; the sledge is the integral base. Bulky, greedy, slow.
caption: The Hauler-Sledge — Heavy support / mobile Hold (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Reach-Runner Outriders
body: a spindly runner sprinting flat-out, a long skimming-pole carried level for balance, body stretched mid-stride with one foot barely touching the base, light scavenged oilskins flapping, otherwise empty-handed. Pure speed, sprinting, thin.
caption: Reach-Runner Outriders — Ultra-cheap chaff / screen (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: The Undertow
body: a tall stooped hierophant of the salt-dead, half-dissolving into salt-crust and trailing strands of dripping brine, blind eyes weeping moulded rivulets down a fissured face; one ruined hand raised and pointing forward, the other open and weeping, draped in sodden disintegrating shrouds that merge into the base. Mournful, dissolving, prophetic.
caption: The Undertow — Eldest Grief-Touched Hierophant (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Maren Eb, the Twice-Wet
body: a drowned ex-merchant cantor, half her oilskin coat rotted to salt-rags and grown through with barnacle-crust, wading with a curved edited trader's hook in one hand and a long barbed heretic's goad in the other; brine streaming from a tilted face, pulped ledger-scraps fused to her belt. Apostate, waterlogged, beckoning.
caption: Maren Eb, the Twice-Wet — Brine-Wet Cantor-Prime (apostate) (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Wadeling Drift
body: a cluster of three freshly-risen drowned wadelings on one swarm base, translucent half-formed salt-dead in tattered salt-fused rags, all wading forward with arms outstretched and hands grasping low to smother an unseen prize, faces blank and melting. A three-figure swarm, one base.
caption: Wadeling Drift — Expendable core swarm / chaff (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Tide-Drowned Bulwark
body: a massive ancient salt-dead grown into a walking statue, encased head to foot in accreted plates of barnacled salt-glass, planted immovably with both barnacled fists lowered and braced, half-fused to the crust at the feet; hunched, monolithic, rooted. Statuesque, armoured, anchored.
caption: Tide-Drowned Bulwark — Durable anchor / zone holder (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Lees-Walker Vigilants
body: a gaunt dry-walking salt-dead caked in cracking boneyard salt-crust, striding deliberately with both vigil-crusted hands spread low and pressing down as if smothering something beneath, head bowed in grim vigil; flaking dry crust shedding from the limbs. Purposeful, desecrating.
caption: Lees-Walker Vigilants — Specialist disruptor / Dry-zone striker (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Brine-Wet Cantor
body: a mobile salt-dead cantor wading briskly, raising a long heretic's goad in one hand and swinging a small iodine censer in the other, tide-reader's ledger-scraps pinned and fluttering across a sodden robe; head turned reading the horizon, brine dripping. Active, directing.
caption: Brine-Wet Cantor — Mobile support / tide manipulation (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Murmur-Host
body: a dense packed mass of four or five overlapping translucent salt-dead on one wide swarm base, shoulder to shoulder, all reaching and grasping with open chorus-hands, mouths open in a silent murmur, bodies melting into one another and into the crust. A crowded multi-figure swarm.
caption: Murmur-Host — Massed area-control swarm (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Standing Salt (Erasure-Born)
body: a towering half-formed monstrosity of erasure-born salt, a crackling unstable avalanche of crystal and drowned limbs barely holding a humanoid shape, rearing up huge with a great half-formed arm raised to crash down; jagged glass shards bristling, mass sloughing off the base. Colossal, unstable, looming.
caption: Standing Salt (Erasure-Born) — Heavy one-shot shock (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: The Stranded
body: a desperate drying salt-dead in a cracking flaking salt-shell, lunging at full extension with one arm thrown out in a last-moment reach, the body already crumbling to powder at the trailing edge, off-balance and spending itself. Reaching, crumbling, doomed.
caption: The Stranded — Forlorn-hope skirmisher (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Salt-Stranded Drowner
body: a hunched drowned hauler in a sodden rope drag-harness, leaning hard into the pull with both hands gripping a heavy chain over the shoulder, dragging a large faceted crystal behind it across the crust; straining low and waterlogged, the dragged crystal part of the base. Toiling, hauling.
caption: Salt-Stranded Drowner — Crystal-dragger / prize escort (unpainted plastic, faction shade).

name: Iodine-Blind Chorister
body: a blind salt-dead chorister kneeling over a small midden-heap of loose salt-glass shards, one thinning-touch hand pressed down breaking the shards apart and the other raised and dripping; a cradle of broken glass at the knees, a blind weeping face. Kneeling, tending, sacrificial.
caption: Iodine-Blind Chorister — Grief-pool accelerant / midden-tender (unpainted plastic, faction shade).
